research_question: Can RAKL distinguish weak shared-category/parent relations from evidence-bearing shared generators, preserve instance-specific deviations and evidence ancestry, and transport only generator-level structure that survives explicit intervention/query/regime checks?

worlds.description: Apple and banana share only a taxonomic fruit category; no mechanism or intervention correspondence is supplied.
Two objects share a declared parent concept but no generator-level invariance evidence.
Two systems share a feedback schema at L6 but have different mechanisms and substrates.
Source and target share a mechanism family, typed roles, compatible regime and mapped query semantics, but target evidence has not been run.
Source and target lift to the same generator and all registered intervention/query probes commute within tolerance.
A causal shared-generator claim lacks an intervention/query commutation result.
The proposed shared generator predicts incompatible mapped intervention effects.
Source and target map to the same abstract generator name but have no overlapping validity regime for the transported claim.
Source and target lifts are certified at different abstraction levels with no explicit level-transition map.
A required generator core feature is preserved in one sibling but explicitly NOT_PRESERVED in another.
Three sibling papers support the same generator signature but all descend from one evidence/theory lineage.
The same generator signature survives across at least two evidence lineages and two environments.
One sibling violates a required core feature while other siblings support it; the outlier must be preserved, not forced into the generator family.
One sibling has insufficient evidence on a required core feature; it must remain unknown rather than counted as support or refutation.
The generator witness remains valid but the transported target-domain claim fails its frozen target test.
Evaluator-side generator membership or expected transfer outcome is exposed while constructing the map.
The generator definition or required core features are changed after inspecting sibling outcomes.
A category-only relation is mislabeled as mechanism/generator evidence to authorize transport.

acceptance_rule: Support code may be promoted only if the exact candidate head passes the unchanged test workflow, all hostile worlds represented by tests behave as frozen, protected evaluator/workflow inputs remain unchanged, and no operation can grant target authority without target evidence.
null_rule: If generator-level contracts add no diagnostic separation beyond the existing typed similarity witness on frozen hostile worlds, do not add active workflow complexity; preserve the simpler existing contract.
authority_boundary: The benchmark can validate method-control behavior only. It cannot establish that any real scientific generator or transfer is true.
